messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: canary-telemetry-slo fired for service=redwood-inference.canary; rule=canary_p99_latency_drift; value=1420ms; threshold=1000ms; span=5m; link=https://telemetry.redwood/internal/alerts/3410001234
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-7821 created and paged primary: @oncall-ivy ; escalation policy=canary-oncall.
oncall-ivy: ack'd via pagerduty. I'm on it, taking first triage.
sanjay: I'm around, pulling up logs and canary rollout details. Which canary id?
oncall-ivy: canary rollout id=rls-2026-04-12-c17, traffic=5% to v2, region=us-west1.
lucas: saw a small bump on staging yesterday but dismissed as noise. curious if rollout changed batching config.
anya: i'm checking the runtime traces and kvcache hit rates now.
eng-runtime: flagged — we pushed a serialization micro-optim for kv-store in the v2 image; rollout included it.
incident-bot: Related events: deploy.rls-2026-04-12-c17 at 3410000900; config.change=batching.max_batch_ms=16 -> 24 for v2.
sanjay: grabbing p99 timeseries: `p99_latency{env="canary",model="v2"}` shows a step from ~700ms -> ~1400ms aligned with deploy timestamp.
anya: kvcache miss rate for v2 jumped from 6% -> 28% post-deploy. Possibly serialization change increased cold-key overhead.
oncall-ivy: customer impact check — any increase in 5xxs or timeouts?
lucas: errors no, 5xx stable; but client-side timeouts increased (we see more client aborts after 10s). A small but growing set of large-context requests are hitting p99.
product-ops: any billing/customer visible degradations? We need to know if any paying tenants hit timeouts.
sanjay: filtering by tenant: two high-traffic customers show ~0.8% requests >10s, up from 0.02%. I'll DM account owners.
eng-runtime: quick mitigation idea: reduce v2 traffic back to 0% (traffic cut) and route all canary to v1 while we debug, or enable fallback model shard for large contexts.
oncall-ivy: agreed — plan: 1) scale down rollout to 0% traffic 2) create temporary traffic diversion rule 3) run a lightweight rollback if traffic cut doesn't lower p99 in 2 min. Executing step 1 now.
incident-bot: Traffic split changed: rls-2026-04-12-c17 traffic 5% -> 0% by oncall-ivy at 3410001360.
sanjay: after traffic cut, p99 for canary group dropping — now 760ms at 3410001420, trending toward baseline. Good sign.
anya: confirming kvcache miss rate decreasing back to ~8% for observed host pools.
lucas: routing change reduced client timeouts; account owners notified. Product-ops: can we mark customer impact as "brief latency spike for small subset — partial timeouts"?
product-ops: yes — classify as "degraded latency for small subset (0.8% of requests for 2 customers), no increased error rate". We'll prepare a short customer message template.
oncall-ivy: escalating to release lead for rollback decision — @eng-runtime @sanjay @lucas. Do we want full rollback?
eng-runtime: serialization micro-opt looks culprit. We should revert that change and run QA on a canary branch, but since traffic cut stabilized, we can opt for a revert + staged rollout. Recommend revert PR now and a hotfix canary tomorrow.
sanjay: opening revert PR and tagging @eng-runtime for review. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/repo/pulls/2345
anya: suggest we add a temporary kvcache warmup hook to reduce cold-key penalties while patch lands. Small puppet script can preheat keys for affected shards.
oncall-ivy: timeline: 3410001234 alert -> 3410001360 traffic cut (0% v2) -> 3410001420 p99 improves -> 3410001600 revert PR opened -> 3410001700 rollback/hotfix plan agreed.
pagerduty-bot: PD incident PD-7821 status: acknowledged by oncall-ivy; notes updated with mitigation actions.
lucas: postmortem owner needed — volunteering: lucas (eng-sre) to run the incident writeup, with inputs from @sanjay and @anya.
product-ops: coordinate a short customer note: we will draft 1-2 sentences to proactively notify the two affected accounts; keep it factual + apology.
oncall-ivy: handoff: I'm stepping off after stabilization; oncall rotation continues. Please escalate if p99 climbs above 1s again or if 5xx increases.
eng-runtime: thumbs up on revert PR, running full unit/integ checks. Will hold off on re-rollout until kvcache prewarm is in place.
anya: i'll prepare prewarm script and a small smoke job to validate before we reintroduce v2.
sanjay: also adding a regression alert on kvcache-miss-rate to catch this earlier next time: rule=kvcache_miss_rate_canary > 15% for 3m.
incident-bot: Incident PD-7821 resolved (mitigated) at 3410001899 — root cause suspected serialization change increasing cold-key overhead; rollback + prewarm planned. Postmortem assigned to lucas.
oncall-ivy: thanks team — nice coordination. :thumbsup:
lucas: adding final notes to PD and the deployment ticket. Will post postmortem draft in #postmortems in ~24h.
product-ops: drafting customer communication and will share for review.
anya: leaving monitoring hooks and a lightweight dashboard for canary telemetry drift.
eng-runtime: followups: revert CI, add prewarm, add regression alert, update rollout checklist to include kvcache warmup.
incident-bot: closing thread — followups tracked in ticket rls-2026-04-12-incident-7821.
